title: The Prompt Triangle: A Registered Report on Prompts as Hybrid Artifacts
abstract: arXiv:2609.04209v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-based coding assistants are transforming software development by shifting effort from writing code to crafting prompts that guide code generation. Despite their growing importance, little empirical evidence exists on how prompts function as software engineering artifacts. Building on prior work framing prompts as mixed artifacts combining requirement intent and solution guidance, we build on the Prompt Triangle, a conceptual model describing prompts along three components: Functionality and Quality (requirements), General Solutions (architectural guidance), and Specific Solutions (implementation constraints). This registered report presents the Stage 1 protocol for a confirmatory study investigating how prompts evolve and how their alignment with requirements engineering (RE) activities predicts development outcomes. translated_title: 提示三角：关于提示词作为混合工件的注册报告
translated_abstract: 基于人工智能的编码助手正在变革软件开发方式，将开发人员的精力从编写代码转移到编写用于引导代码生成的提示词上。尽管提示词的重要性日益增长，但关于提示词如何作为软件工程工件发挥作用的实证证据仍然很少。在先前将提示词视为结合需求意图与解决方案指导的混合工件的研究基础上，我们构建了“提示三角”，这是一个从三个组成部分描述提示词的概念模型：功能性与质量（需求）、通用解决方案（架构指导）以及特定解决方案（实现约束）。本注册报告提出了一项验证性研究的阶段一（Stage 1）协议，该研究旨在调查提示词如何演变，以及提示词与需求工程（RE）活动的对齐程度如何预测开发结果。我们预先注册了四个假设，用于考察提示词演变、开发者特征、需求工程活动对齐以及时间相关因素……
tldr: 该论文提出“提示三角”概念模型，将提示词划分为功能性与质量、通用解决方案和特定解决方案三个组成部分，并注册一项验证性研究协议，以实证考察提示词作为软件工程混合工件的演变规律及其与需求工程活动对齐程度对开发结果的预测作用。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Prompt Triangle, a conceptual model decomposing prompts into Functionality & Quality, General Solutions, and Specific Solutions, and presents a preregistered confirmatory study protocol to empirically investigate how prompts evolve as hybrid software engineering artifacts and how their alignment with requirements engineering activities predicts development outcomes.
